raw_response:
This plot is very small, only a tenth of a kebele's measure, and it is planted with my perennial trees and enset together with some other crops mixed in. I have no schooling and no cash to waste on chemical fertilizer for this little plot — I save the fertilizer for my bigger teff and maize fields where the cooperative gives me DAP and urea. For the trees and enset I use manure from my animals, that is what my father did and it keeps the soil alive. I do not irrigate here, the rains are enough in SNNP, and I work this plot myself with my wife and children — no money to hire people for such a small piece.
